authority: Canonical live status for the Japan and Italy external-regime validation exercises. Frozen protocols and execution plans are historical records, not current-status sources.

japan.label: Japan

development.summary: Full extended-channel and household-chain development runs are complete. The full mechanism did not beat the lagged-trend kill comparator with the required certainty, and extended US channels generally reduced transfer.

workingAge.summary: Still sealed pending the official 2025 municipal age tabulation, announced for September 2026. It must use the already frozen pipeline.

household.summary: The mechanism beat no-migration on MAE but lost to the lagged household trend on both MAE and within-basin rank.

vacancy.summary: Secondary outcome; it cannot reverse a primary failure.

landPrice.summary: Secondary outcome; it cannot reverse a primary failure.

overall.claim: Scenario tooling; no internationally validated resilience label.
overall.basis: The opened household primary failed. The pending working-age primary can add narrower evidence but cannot make all frozen v1 gates pass.

remainingPermissibleWork: Acquire the official 2025 municipal age tabulation and run the frozen working-age holdout without retuning.
Acquire 2020-origin commuting basins and recompute the already opened household local metrics as logged.
Run the preregistered secondary vacancy and land-price outcomes, clearly labeled secondary.
japan.nextModelRule: Any feature, coefficient, comparator, or gate change informed by the opened household outcome is exploratory or requires a newly preregistered v2.

italy.label: Italy

development.summary: The preregistered demographic-core development run is complete. It trailed lagged trend in both windows and missed the Milano and Roma hierarchy cases.

workingAge.summary: The mechanism lost to no-migration on MAE and did not beat lagged trend with a confidence interval above zero.

household.summary: Secondary 2011-2021 census outcome; it cannot reverse the working-age primary failure.

vacancy.summary: Not specified as an Italy outcome in the frozen protocol.

landPrice.summary: Secondary OMI outcome; it cannot reverse the working-age primary failure.

overall.claim: Scenario tooling; not externally validated in Italy.
overall.basis: The opened working-age primary failed both preregistered gates.

remainingPermissibleWork: Run the frozen secondary 2011-2021 household outcome.
Run the frozen secondary OMI land-price outcome.
Treat acquisition of the previously unavailable full institutional feature set as exploratory unless a v2 is preregistered.
italy.nextModelRule: Because the working-age holdout is open, feature or weight changes are exploratory or require a newly preregistered v2.
